declaredIntent.summary: Publish only v0.5.61 from the latest verified default-branch source through the authoritative same-SHA rehearsal and release workflow, so the remediated CodeQL findings are available in an immutable template release.

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish only v0.5.61 after readiness, a successful matching same-SHA rehearsal, actual workflow verification, provider asset/install validation, and final Work Item cleanup. No gate bypass, historical tag mutation, or blind retry is authorized.

riskAssessment.reason: This creates an immutable public tag and assets; only source/tag/receipt identity evidence and all hosted gates permit publication.

reasons: Public immutable publication and provider evidence require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized this constrained release after every fail-closed gate passes.

preReviewWarnings: Resolve the current default-branch SHA immediately before rehearsal; any source, tag, receipt, asset, installer, or CodeQL-closure mismatch blocks publication.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record publication evidence before final Outcome and lifecycle closure.

acceptance: check-release-readiness passes on synchronized origin/main and identifies v0.5.61 as the only eligible next candidate.
A release.yml rehearsal succeeds for the resolved origin/main SHA and v0.5.61, its private receipt matches exactly, and no v0.5.61 tag, Release, or public asset exists before actual publication.

The actual release.yml run consumes that exact receipt and succeeds with the v0.5.61 tag, provider Release, assets, checksums/digests, SBOM/provenance, installer identity, and strict smoke bound to one source SHA.

The three remediated CodeQL alerts remain closed on the released main source, and the Work Item records external evidence truthfully, completes archive/PR/merge/close, and leaves no open Work Item branch or unresolved release lifecycle state.

guidelines: Use only release.yml for immutable provider mutations; never create tags or Releases manually.
Preserve readiness → same-SHA rehearsal → actual release order and fail closed on every identity mismatch.
Treat Outcome and provider receipts as evidence, not as substitutes for verified release facts.

intent.problem: The release workflow security remediation is merged on main, CodeQL has confirmed alerts #2, #3, and #4 are closed, and the current v0.5.61 candidate must now make the fixed template available to adopters.
constraints: Use the latest freshly resolved origin/main SHA, v0.5.61 only, and release.yml only.
Do not manually alter source, tags, Releases, assets, or release projections.
Stop and preserve evidence on any failed, missing, stale, or mismatched gate.
intent.rationale: A patch release is necessary for adopters to consume the security fix through an immutable, source-bound template version while retaining a complete recovery and evidence chain.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized completing the required Work Item lifecycle and requested that authority be recorded in each Contract; this authority is bounded by the exact v0.5.61 release workflow and never authorizes a gate bypass.
